description: This source file contains unit tests for the AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter class, verifying its behavior in various scenarios such as startup, message processing, error handling, tenant configurations, command and telemetry message forwarding, limits enforcement, and gateway mapping logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks and common fixtures used in multiple test cases, setting up dependencies such as Vertx, Context, factories, clients, and metrics.

methods.name: testStartUsesClientProvidedHttpServer
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter uses a provided HttpServer instance and correctly binds request handlers and listener.

methods.name: testStartInvokesOnStartupSuccess
methods.description: Checks that the onStartupSuccess callback is called after successful server startup.

methods.name: testStartDoesNotInvokeOnStartupSuccessIfStartupFails
methods.description: Ensures that onStartupSuccess callback is not invoked if server startup fails.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Verifies that telemetry upload fails with 403 if the tenant is disabled for the adapter.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryFailsForUnknownDevice
methods.description: Ensures telemetry upload responds with 404 if the device is not registered.

methods.name: testUploadEventWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Checks that the event upload waits for downstream acceptance before responding with 202.

methods.name: testUploadEventFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Ensures rejection responses are correctly handled and result in a 400 status.

methods.name: testUploadEventWithTimeToLive
methods.description: Verifies that time-to-live headers are correctly propagated into downstream messages.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Checks that command responses wait for downstream acceptance before responding.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Verifies that command responses fail with 403 if the tenant is not enabled for processing commands.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Checks that the upload responds with 404 if device registration is missing but credentials exist.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Ensures command responses that are not accepted downstream result in 400 errors.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryDoesNotWaitForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that telemetry messages are responded to immediately without downstream acceptance wait.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryRemovesTtdIfCommandConsumerIsInUse
methods.description: Checks that TTD header is omitted if the command consumer is currently in use.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithTtdClosesCommandConsumerIfSenderCreationFailed
methods.description: Ensures that the command consumer is closed if telemetry sender creation fails.

methods.name: testIsGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Verifies the logic of enabling or disabling gateway mapping based on tenant configuration.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithDisabledGatewayMapping
methods.description: Checks correct behavior when the gateway mapping support is disabled via tenant settings, including setting last known gateway and creating appropriate command consumer.

methods.name: testUploadEmptyNotificationSucceedsIfCommandConsumerIsInUse
methods.description: Ensures that an empty notification event is accepted and does not send downstream if the command consumer is busy.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryUsesConfiguredMaxTtd
methods.description: Verifies that the max TTD setting is correctly respected, overriding device-specified TTD values.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForATelemetryMessage
methods.description: Ensures that when message limit is exceeded, telemetry uploads are rejected with 429.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForAnEventMessage
methods.description: Checks rejection of event messages when message limits are exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForACommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Verifies rejection of command response messages when message limits are exceeded.
